description: This file is a Perl module defining the 'Git::SVN::Fetcher' package, which implements a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor to handle tree delta callbacks for 'git svn fetch'. It contains methods for processing directory and file changes, properties, and special handling for empty directories and placeholders, to facilitate synchronization between Subversion and Git repositories.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A Perl module subclassing SVN::Delta::Editor to handle Subversion tree deltas in a way that updates git-svn's internal index and metadata, managing files, directories, properties, and special cases like empty directories and placeholders.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Fetcher object, setting up repository configurations, ignore/include regexes, placeholder settings, and internal state hashes.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Opens the root directory, returning a hash with the path.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Opens a directory at a specified path, returning a hash with the path.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a SVN path to a git-compatible path, applying encoding and path stripping if configured.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory at a given path, updating internal state and removing entries from git index.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Opens a file at a specified path, retrieving its mode and blob hash from SVN, and prepares a file handle for delta application.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Prepares a new file entry in the index, handling placeholders and setting mode.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Prepares a new directory entry, removing any existing placeholder files, updating internal state regarding emptiness.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Sets a directory property value in internal state.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Records a directory that is present but cannot be conveyed, typically due to permissions issues.

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Records a file that is present but cannot be conveyed.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Sets a file property value in internal state, handling executable and special modes.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Prepares handling of a text delta, acquiring temporary files and establishing a delta application context.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes a file after delta application, computing the hash, handling symlink cases, and updating the git index.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the editing session, cleaning up internal index state.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the editing session, handling empty directories and placeholders, and calls superclass method.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Identifies directories that are empty after deletions by checking git tree listings.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Adds a placeholder file in an empty directory to prevent its removal.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Stores the list of added placeholder files into SVN configuration for future reference.
